label: Blind sample burn 012: MTBS Flat Top fire, ID, 2019-09-06

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.08 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 6 Sep 2019 (90% interval −0.28 to +0.01). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 1 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.03). Counted by gap size instead, 2 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.05). The interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out.
reasons: the interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar passes every test on its own: radar backscatter (VH) −0.6 dB, interval −1.0 to −0.3.
